title: 第三章 所谓制片人中心制
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“这？！这是哪里拍到的？！”

苏行舟没有把照片直接递给潘岳明，只是让他看了两眼，脸色就憋得青紫。

不知道是因为拿到证据过于高兴，还是因为一个男人被绿倍感耻辱。

“苏总，您这是？”

陈姐不确定地问道。

天降优质剧本到拿出董婕出轨证据，她摸不清苏行舟打的什么主意。

总不可能一位老总跑来当狗仔，想把照片卖个好价钱吧？

苏行舟看着神情激动的二人，笑了笑。

“潘哥，你和董婕的事情爆发之后，我就坚定地相信你不是新闻里报道的那种人！”

“我....”

潘岳明说不出话，他多少朋友都连忙和他划清界限，苏行舟这个陌生人却如此相信他。

这就是被信任的感觉吗？

今天受到的刺激太多了，他感觉脑袋有些缺氧了。

“所以我才派出狗仔，想要为你查出一个真相。幸不辱命，真拍到了。”

“那这些照片？”

到底是要钱还是要什么，潘岳明此时只想苏行舟开门见山，哪怕狮子大开口他也认了。

只要有这些照片，他就可以在舆论场反转。

“潘哥，我们是合作关系，我希望咱们能一起配合....”

潘岳明坐在位置上，听着苏行舟说完他的全盘打算，怔愣坐在椅子上。

苏行舟的打算是这些料不急着放，要好好的做一番文章，把《白夜追凶》配合这场舆论推到顶峰，然后在最关键的时候放出证据反转舆论。

这就是苏行舟作为制片人在开发项目环节，和发行营销环节要做的文章。

p站的用户量和日活增长数据早就陷入了停滞。

没有大网站的用户量，《白夜追凶》有可能扑得悄无声息。

可惜苏行舟重生的时间线晚了点，要不然他最应该做的是《万万没想到》《屌丝男士》这样的3分钟的段子剧，成本低，传播快。

但《万万没想到》已经成稿在拍摄了。

截胡不了《万万没想到》就没必要搞这类型的快餐短剧了。

网剧市场变化太快，《万万没想到》大火之后，这类型短剧的热度就逐渐散去，网剧朝着类型化，精品化的趋势发展。

综合市场考量，苏行舟知道悬疑网剧是这几年趋势。

"This?! Where was this taken?!"

Su Xingzhou didn't hand the photo directly to Pan Yueming, but just let him look at it twice, and his face turned purple from holding back.

I don’t know if it’s because I’m too happy to get the evidence, or because I feel humiliated by a man being raped.

"Mr. Su, what are you doing?"

Sister Chen asked uncertainly.

From the gift of a high-quality script to the evidence of Dong Jie's cheating, she couldn't figure out what Su Xingzhou had in mind.

It's impossible for a boss to come here and act as a paparazzi and try to sell the photos for a good price, right?

Su Xingzhou looked at the excited two people and smiled.

"Brother Pan, after the incident between you and Dong Jie broke out, I firmly believed that you are not the kind of person reported in the news!"

"I..."

Pan Yueming was speechless. Many of his friends quickly distanced themselves from him, but Su Xingzhou, a stranger, believed in him so much.

Is this what it feels like to be trusted?

He had received too much stimulation today, and he felt like his head was lacking oxygen.

"That's why I sent the paparazzi to find out the truth for you. Fortunately, I lived up to my mission and got it captured."

"What about these photos?"

Whether he wanted money or something else, Pan Yueming just wanted Su Xingzhou to get straight to the point. Even if the lion opened his mouth, he would admit it.

As long as he has these photos, he can reverse the public opinion.

"Brother Pan, we are in a cooperative relationship. I hope we can cooperate together..."

Pan Yueming sat in his seat, listening to Su Xingzhou finish explaining his overall plan, and sat in a daze on the chair.

Su Xingzhou's plan was not to release these materials in a hurry, but to write a good article to push the public opinion of "White Night" to the peak, and then release the evidence to reverse the public opinion at the most critical moment.

This is what Su Xingzhou, as a producer, has to do in the project development and distribution and marketing stages.

The number of users and daily active growth data of station p has long been stagnant.

Without the user base of a large website, "White Night Chase" might have become silent.

It's a pity that Su Xingzhou's rebirth timeline is a little late, otherwise what he should do most is 3-minute joke dramas such as "Unexpectedly" and "Diaosi Man", which are low-cost and spread quickly.

But "Never Expected" has been completed and is being filmed.

If "Unexpectedly" can't be cut off, there is no need to engage in this type of fast food short drama.

The online drama market is changing too fast. After "Unexpectedly" became a hit, the popularity of this type of short dramas gradually dissipated, and online dramas developed towards genres and high-quality products.

Based on market considerations, Su Xingzhou knows that suspense web dramas have been a trend in recent years.
